from collections import Counter

def should_exclude(t):
    lbl=(t.get('label') or '')
    is_priority = lbl.lower().startswith('priority')
    is_star = bool(t.get('starred'))
    return is_priority or is_star

inbox_excluded=[t for t in inbox_threads if should_exclude(t)]
inbox_included=[t for t in inbox_threads if not should_exclude(t)]
print('inbox total', len(inbox_threads))
print('inbox excluded', len(inbox_excluded))
print('inbox included', len(inbox_included))
print('inbox excluded breakdown priority-star', sum(1 for t in inbox_excluded if (t.get('label') or '').lower().startswith('priority') and t.get('starred')),
      'priority only', sum(1 for t in inbox_excluded if (t.get('label') or '').lower().startswith('priority') and not t.get('starred')),
      'starred only', sum(1 for t in inbox_excluded if not (t.get('label') or '').lower().startswith('priority') and t.get('starred')))

outbox_excluded=[t for t in outbox_threads if should_exclude(t)]
outbox_included=[t for t in outbox_threads if not should_exclude(t)]
print('outbox total', len(outbox_threads))
print('outbox excluded', len(outbox_excluded))
print('outbox included', len(outbox_included))
print('outbox excluded breakdown priority-star', sum(1 for t in outbox_excluded if (t.get('label') or '').lower().startswith('priority') and t.get('starred')),
      'priority only', sum(1 for t in outbox_excluded if (t.get('label') or '').lower().startswith('priority') and not t.get('starred')),
      'starred only', sum(1 for t in outbox_excluded if not (t.get('label') or '').lower().startswith('priority') and t.get('starred')))

# list ids
inbox_ids=[t['email_thread_id'] for t in inbox_included]
outbox_ids=[t['email_thread_id'] for t in outbox_included]
print('inbox ids included', inbox_ids)
print('outbox ids included', outbox_ids)
print('total to archive', len(inbox_ids)+len(outbox_ids))

    return [t['email_thread_id'] for t in thread_list]

def fetch_inbox_read():
    out=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        page=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=token, read=True, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('inbox read page', i, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        out.extend(page)
        i+=1
    return out

def fetch_outbox_read():
    out=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        page=apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=token, read=True, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('outbox read page', i, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        out.extend(page)
        i+=1
    return out

def fetch_archived():
    out=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        page=apis.gmail.show_archived_threads(access_token=token, read=True, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('archived read page', i, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        out.extend(page)
        i+=1
    return out
